visualCharacteristics: Grid of article preview cards: each card has a 4:3 image on top, then a meta row (category tag + date) and a title heading. Four columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile. Cards are links.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row is a card with an image cell and a body cell (tag + date meta and a title, optionally wrapped in a link).
usage: Latest-articles / blog listing showing linked article previews.
